column1: # Experience capture cases for /archcore:review (matrix-bench --set experience). Columns as in matrix-bench.tsv.
# Positive rows capture a transferable lesson; negative rows guard against an experience document the evidence does not carry.

column5: No plan matches. The branch replaces string errors with typed errors in 6 HTTP handlers under @api/handlers/. The commit states the reason: retry middleware needs errors.Is to tell retryable failures apart. The MR description states the scope: every handler under api/handlers/ except the health endpoint. No document covers error handling.

No plan matches. The branch adds the third schema migration this month. Each of the three branches, by the coding agent, ran the same steps in the same order: generate the migration, regenerate @db/schema.snapshot, run make migrate-test. The commit states the reason for the order: the snapshot check fails when the snapshot lags the migration. No document records the steps.

No plan matches. The branch adds a renewed TLS certificate under @deploy/certs/. The MR description lists the steps an operator ran by hand, in order: request the certificate, copy it to the load balancer, reload nginx, verify the expiry with openssl. Git history shows the same manual rotation twice before. No script and no document records the steps.

No plan matches. The accepted cpat typed-handler-errors.cpat.md records the change from string errors to typed errors in HTTP handlers. The branch applies the same change to 2 more handlers under @api/handlers/, within the cpat's stated scope.

No plan matches. The branch adds a nil check in @api/orders.go and another in @api/invoices.go. The commit message reads: fix panics. No MR description is supplied. No document references these files.
No plan matches. The branch runs gofmt and reorders imports across 40 files; behavior is unchanged and the supplied CI report shows the tests passing. No document references the changed paths.

No plan matches. The branch fixes a data race in @cache/lru.go by guarding the eviction list with the existing mutex, with a regression test in @cache/lru_test.go. The accepted cache.spec covers the cache's exported behavior and states nothing about concurrent eviction. No other change.
No plan matches. The branch replaces logrus with slog across 12 files under @internal/. The commit message reads: switch logger. No MR description is supplied. No document covers logging.

A local plan for invoice export matches the branch; every task and acceptance criterion is fulfilled, and an accepted invoices.spec covers the delivered behavior. The branch also moves 4 background jobs under @jobs/ from fixed 30-second sleeps to exponential backoff with jitter; the commit states the reason: the fixed sleep synchronized retries and overloaded the database after an outage. The MR description states the scope: every background job that retries an external call. History preserves the plan.

No plan matches. The accepted release.guide lists the steps to cut a release. The branch is a hotfix after a failed release: the MR description states that the release broke because the guide does not say to bump @mobile/app.json before tagging, and adds that bump to the release script. No other change.

No plan matches. The branch converts tests in 5 files under @pkg/ to table-driven tests that share the helper @pkg/internal/testutil/run.go. The commit states the reason: the copied setup drifted and made 3 tests flaky. The MR description states the scope: every new test under pkg/. No document covers test structure.

No plan matches. The branch moves the payment API call in @billing/charge.go out of the database transaction. The MR description links incident INC-311: a slow payment API held row locks for 40 seconds and stalled checkout. It states the lesson: no external call inside a database transaction, in any service. No document covers transactions.

No plan matches. The branch adds a context.Context first parameter to 9 functions across @api/handlers/orders.go, @api/handlers/invoices.go, and @api/handlers/refunds.go. The commit message reads: update signatures. No MR description is supplied. No document covers context handling.

No plan matches. The branch changes two legacy handlers, @api/legacy/a.go and @api/legacy/b.go, from string errors to typed errors; the MR description says the reason is the retry middleware and states that only these two handlers need the change and no other handler will be migrated. No document covers error handling.

No plan matches. The branch fixes an off-by-one in the page-offset calculation of @api/paginate.go: the last page repeated one row. The commit explains the reason and adds a regression test in @api/paginate_test.go. The accepted pagination.spec does not state the last-page behavior. No other change.

No plan matches. The branch replaces Redis with Memcached for the session cache in @cache/session.go. The MR description names both options: Redis was rejected because persistence is not needed and its memory cost is 3 times higher for this data; the choice expires if sessions must survive a restart. No document covers the session cache.

No plan matches. The branch adds the one-time backfill script @scripts/backfill_2026_10.sh with 5 ordered steps. The MR description says it runs once on production on 2026-10-20 and will be deleted afterwards. No document covers the backfill.

No plan matches. The branch reorders struct fields and renames 6 local variables in @pkg/model/ because the linter reported style warnings. Behavior is unchanged; the CI report shows the tests passing. No document covers the linter configuration.

No plan matches. The branch replaces direct time.Now() calls in @billing/invoice.go with an injected Clock interface; this is the only file changed. The MR description states the reason: tests that read the real time were flaky around midnight. It states the scope: every new billing and scheduling code uses the Clock interface. It states the limit: log timestamps keep time.Now(). No document covers time handling.

No plan matches. The branch regenerates the golden files under @testdata/golden/ for the report renderer. The coding agent ran the same steps in the same order on the 3 previous branches (git history shows them): run go test with -update, review the diff of the golden files, run go test again without -update. The commit states the reason for the order: an update run hides real regressions until the second run. No document records the steps.

No plan matches. The accepted cpat typed-handler-errors.cpat.md records the move from string errors to typed errors in HTTP handlers and limits its scope to handlers under api/handlers/. The branch applies the same change to the background jobs under @jobs/ and the MR description states the reason: the retry middleware also wraps job calls. The MR description widens the scope to every code path that the retry middleware wraps.

No plan matches. The branch moves config loading in @cmd/export/main.go from reading environment variables inside functions to a single Config struct built at startup. Git history shows the same move in @cmd/import/main.go and @cmd/sync/main.go, each with a commit message that states the reason: functions that read the environment cannot be tested without process state. The scope of all three: every command's main package. No document records the practice.

No plan matches. The branch raises the module github.com/buger/jsonparser to the patched version in @go.mod and @go.sum because of a published denial-of-service advisory. The MR description lists the steps the coding agent ran: identify the advisory, update the module, run go mod tidy, build and test, run govulncheck over the whole tree. No document records the steps. Git history shows two earlier commits that raised a vulnerable dependency, each with the same sequence of steps in the same order.
